elements.element: Customer owns deliverables created for it.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) states that Client owns all right, title and interest in all deliverables of the Support Services created for Client.

elements.element: Customer owns work product created for it.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) states that Client owns all right, title and interest in all work product of the Support Services created for Client.

elements.element: Vendor assigns all right, title and interest in deliverables created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) provides that TrueLink “hereby assigns to Client” all right, title and interest in the covered deliverables.

elements.element: Vendor assigns all right, title and interest in work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) provides that TrueLink “hereby assigns to Client” all right, title and interest in the covered work product.

elements.element: Vendor retains ownership of its pre-existing IP.
elements.evidence: Section 2(d) expressly preserves TrueLink's ownership of the Interface. More generally, the assignment is limited to deliverables and work product created for Client, while embedded TrueLink IP is licensed rather than assigned, leaving pre-existing TrueLink IP with TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor grants Customer a licence to any Vendor IP embedded in the deliverables.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) grants Client a licence to any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in the deliverables.

elements.element: The licence to embedded Vendor IP is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The embedded-IP licence is expressly described as “perpetual.”

elements.element: The licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The embedded-IP licence is expressly described as “irrevocable.”

elements.element: The licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The embedded-IP licence is expressly described as “royalty-free.”

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) states that, except for the preserved Section 8(d) licence, Client retains all right, title and interest in data provided by or on behalf of Client and data generated through Client's use of the Interface.

elements.element: No joint ownership of intellectual property is created.
elements.evidence: Section 2(e) expressly states that no joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by the Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor owns its generic tools.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly retains TrueLink's rights only in the Interface and does not generally reserve ownership of all generic tools, particularly tools developed during the engagement.

elements.element: Vendor owns its know-how.
elements.evidence: No operative language expressly reserves TrueLink's ownership of know-how, including know-how developed in performing the Support Services.

elements.element: Customer receives a licence covering the deliverables.
elements.evidence: Client receives the greater right of ownership in the deliverables, together with a licence to embedded TrueLink IP, functionally providing rights covering the complete deliverables.

elements.element: The deliverables licence permits use.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the licence for embedded TrueLink IP expressly permits use as part of the deliverables.

elements.element: The deliverables licence permits modification.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the licence for embedded TrueLink IP expressly permits modification as part of the deliverables.

elements.element: The deliverables licence permits sublicensing.
elements.evidence: Client owns the deliverables, and the licence for embedded TrueLink IP expressly permits sublicensing as part of the deliverables.

elements.element: The deliverables licence is perpetual.
elements.evidence: Client's assigned ownership is not time-limited, and the licence covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: The deliverables licence is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The ownership assignment is not stated to be revocable, and the licence covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: The deliverables licence is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The embedded TrueLink IP licence contains no worldwide or equivalent territorial scope. The separate worldwide Credit Data licence does not cure this omission.

elements.element: The deliverables licence is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence covering embedded TrueLink IP is expressly royalty-free, and no royalty applies to Client's ownership of the remaining deliverable rights.

elements.element: Customer may exercise the deliverables licence for its business.
elements.evidence: The granted rights are not restricted to another purpose and are broad enough to permit Client to use the deliverables for its business.

result.reason: The redline reaches the preferred position: Client receives ownership by present assignment of Client-created deliverables and work product, an appropriately qualified licence to embedded TrueLink IP, continued ownership of Client data, and an express bar on joint ownership. The fallback is not independently complete because generic tools and know-how are not expressly reserved and the embedded-IP licence is not worldwide. The drafting preserves the Interface ownership and Credit Data licence, but it is not strictly minimal because it unnecessarily reorders existing provisions and adds modification and sublicensing rights beyond the minimum preferred formulation. Duplicate subsection lettering and the absence of an express general pre-existing-IP reservation also reduce drafting clarity.
